GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 004 (8 Nov 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN-251)
8 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Information from Private Insurance Companies.
1. It is desired that all life and non-life insurance companies, under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Finance, transmit the following information to this Headquarters:
a. Name of company.
b. Address of home office.
c. Nature of business (Fire, Life, Marine, etc.).
d. Bonds, stocks, debentures or other securities owned by company classified in groups indicating:
(1) Description of security.
(2) Amount owned (Book and par value).
(3) Rate of interest.
(4) Date of maturity.
(5) If guaranteed by the Imperial Japanese Government, so state.
2. It is expected information submitted will be as of 31 March 1945, or subsequent thereto.
3. Acknowledgment of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
